min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,

sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR

order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.provider_txn_id AS txn, count(*) AS receipts, count(p.id) AS live,
min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,
sum(CASE WHEN r.state IS NOT 'settled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_state,
sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR
p.amount IS NOT r.amount OR p.idempotency_key IS NOT r.recorded_key OR
p.created_at IS NOT r.recorded_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM payment_receipts r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id
WHERE r.provider_txn_id>'provider-130de840508606ee22f9081a' GROUP BY r.provider_txn_id HAVING live>1 OR bad_state>0 OR mismatch>0 OR
order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.provider_txn_id AS txn, count(*) AS receipts, count(p.id) AS live,
min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,
sum(CASE WHEN r.state IS NOT 'settled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_state,
sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR
p.amount IS NOT r.amount OR p.idempotency_key IS NOT r.recorded_key OR
p.created_at IS NOT r.recorded_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM payment_receipts r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id
WHERE r.provider_txn_id>'provider-0877215160a6f66bf73eac94' GROUP BY r.provider_txn_id HAVING live>1 OR bad_state>0 OR mismatch>0 OR
order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.provider_txn_id AS txn, count(*) AS receipts, count(p.id) AS live,
min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,
sum(CASE WHEN r.state IS NOT 'settled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_state,
sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR
p.amount IS NOT r.amount OR p.idempotency_key IS NOT r.recorded_key OR
p.created_at IS NOT r.recorded_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM payment_receipts r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id
WHERE r.provider_txn_id>'provider-0e9a3cedb62f3b171d4b9106' GROUP BY r.provider_txn_id HAVING live>1 OR bad_state>0 OR mismatch>0 OR
order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.provider_txn_id AS txn, count(*) AS receipts, count(p.id) AS live,
min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,
sum(CASE WHEN r.state IS NOT 'settled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_state,
sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR
p.amount IS NOT r.amount OR p.idempotency_key IS NOT r.recorded_key OR
p.created_at IS NOT r.recorded_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM payment_receipts r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id
WHERE r.provider_txn_id>'provider-1916b3d7aa0190de2fb9699f' GROUP BY r.provider_txn_id HAVING live>1 OR bad_state>0 OR mismatch>0 OR
order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10

min(r.order_id) AS order_min,max(r.order_id) AS order_max,
min(r.customer_id) AS customer_min,max(r.customer_id) AS customer_max,
min(r.amount) AS amount_min,max(r.amount) AS amount_max,
sum(CASE WHEN r.state IS NOT 'settled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_state,
sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND
(p.order_id IS NOT r.order_id OR p.customer_id IS NOT r.customer_id OR
p.amount IS NOT r.amount OR p.idempotency_key IS NOT r.recorded_key OR
p.created_at IS NOT r.recorded_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch
FROM payment_receipts r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id=r.payment_id
WHERE r.provider_txn_id>'provider-2097505f03152fab78a15cb6' GROUP BY r.provider_txn_id HAVING live>1 OR bad_state>0 OR mismatch>0 OR
order_min IS NOT order_max OR customer_min IS NOT customer_max OR
amount_min IS NOT amount_max OR length(trim(r.provider_txn_id))=0
ORDER BY r.provider_txn_id LIMIT 10
